resolution: Generation 1 provides a deterministic held-out goal-inference benchmark on accepted F2-WP-800. Policy input is restricted to exact public ObservationView values and immutable public CandidateGoal descriptors. GOAL versus ABSTAIN output is bound to exact run, public fixture, episode, generation, observation and candidate-set identities. Evaluator labels are sealed only after policy output and are now constrained by identifiability from the same declared public evidence. A reproduced falsifier showed that the first implementation could pair ambiguous public evidence with an arbitrary exact hidden goal label and score a matching guess correct. The accepted repair adds evaluator-side public-identifiability binding: ambiguous evidence cannot mint an exact GOAL label, and uniquely identifying public evidence cannot be contradicted by an evaluator label. Exact PR-head and merged-main repository-hosted CI both passed compile and the held-out goal-inference falsification suite. Agreement remains benchmark measurement only and grants no goal-adoption, runtime, VPS, physical GRID10, GWT/J-Space, provider/model, training, effect, completion, world-truth or whole-system credit.

repository_hosted_ci.falsification_suite: PASS: public-only policy boundary, GOAL/ABSTAIN behavior, deterministic baselines, exact identity binding, hidden-state isolation, non-identifiability exact-label rejection and contradictory-label rejection
